objective: test whether completion-aligned, artifact-exact hard-ternary MLP QAT can produce the first CPU-trained Qwen3.5-4B layer candidate that survives mandatory generation capability gates
evidence_boundary: a passing layer-30 result validates the CPU training and export ladder only; it is not a whole-model ternary result or a breakthrough

candidate.scale: MSE-optimal support mean, rounded to FP16 before BF16 hard-weight materialization
candidate.artifact_contract: Clark CQ3_0 group-128 codes and scales
candidate.reason_for_layer: prior Qwen survival experiments found layer 30 safer than neighboring late layers, and its short backward path minimizes CPU cost

teacher_cache.label_semantics: every retained teacher logit predicts a teacher-generated completion token
teacher_cache.required_alignment: generated token present in top-128 at every retained position
teacher_cache.eval_overlap_policy: no CUTE-Quick-20 or MATH-500 evaluation row appears in the training source

controls: the same layer-30 triplet quantized directly to CQ3_0 without training
resource_and_integrity_gates: hash the preregistration, prompt source, model index, caches, checkpoints, and final patch
stop on non-finite loss or gradient
stop if the service exceeds 28 GiB
keep one latest phase-1 checkpoint and one final patch
treat infrastructure errors as invalid rather than capability failures

mandatory_capability_gate.mmlu_substitution: a pinned subject-balanced quick slice is allowed only when character generation cannot be evaluated
mandatory_capability_gate.expansion_rule: do not quantize another layer unless both MATH-500 and CUTE-Quick-20 pass and no other catastrophic signal fires

promotion_rule: promotion requires generation receipts for the exact packed candidate; local MLP loss, teacher KL, and checkpoint completion cannot promote it
